decision.scope: first-error-wins slot provenance for the intermittent cold-first-call BADOPCODE
decision.trigger: Link-52 hardware captured [slot 44, inner 0]; slot 44 was abort cleanup provenance and had overwritten the primary failing phase

storage.lifetime: tail excluded from emitter and append work structs; the first emitter entry resets flags; cold phases stamp the primary byte until rollback, abort or inner-VM entry locks it

writers.decoder_slots: session decoder phases 04 through 12 stamp their actual configured slot while unlocked
writers.emitter_slots: all eight emitter overlay entries stamp their actual configured slot while unlocked
writers.append_slots: forward-only append entries stamp directly; dual-use append and cleanup entries stamp only while unlocked
writers.local_cleanup_lock: rollback_unpublish locks before attempting its own stamp and is the first member of the canonical local rollback plan
writers.nonlocal_cleanup_lock: abort_control locks before attempting its own stamp and precedes every non-local cleanup phase
writers.inner_transition: c2_product_install performs the sole resident provenance store immediately before vm_run_dir; that store sets both INNER_ENTERED and PRIMARY_LOCKED
writers.reset: the first emitter overlay entry clears both flags before stamping itself; pre-overlay transaction/reset failures remain identified by their existing status and are outside the tuple claim

interpretation.first_error_session_slot: the last non-cleanup cold overlay entered before the first rollback/abort boundary, or the last append slot before inner-VM entry
interpretation.inner_vm_entered: trace_flags bit 0 is one iff this install crossed into vm_run_dir
interpretation.primary_locked: trace_flags bit 7 is one after the first cleanup boundary or inner-VM entry; later cleanup stamps are no-ops
interpretation.precedence: the first phase witness wins; cleanup may enrich C2J and the flag byte but may never replace the primary slot
interpretation.success: a completed transient install may retain both bits set; the tuple is provenance, not a success marker

visibility.consumer: read-only JTAG capture after normal fail-closed unwind
